title: The shiur asset, only the leader recorded, the talking head kept, open by link, media in an object store

tasks.title: Only the leader is recorded, with the talking head's place in the timeline
Media in an object store, public reads of a ready recording, the old recordings and chunk table gone

acs.text: WHILE the leader records a session with other people in its call THE SYSTEM SHALL record the recording person's own microphone only: no other participant's audio is mixed in, whatever joins, leaves or speaks

WHILE the leader records THE SYSTEM SHALL draw only the recording person's own camera into the recording's video, and the room's title card while their camera is off; other participants' cameras are never drawn

WHILE the leader records THE SYSTEM SHALL keep, in the recording's reader timeline, a `social.overlay` slice saying whether their camera is on and where their talking head is (the call window's box as fractions of the viewport), updated when either changes

WHEN anyone, signed in or not, asks for a ready recording by its id at `GET /api/v1/assets/{assetId}`, `/api/v1/assets/{assetId}/state` or `/api/v1/assets/{assetId}/media` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer with its metadata (title, the leader's name, duration, no member-only fields), its reader timeline and its media; a recording that is still recording, failed, or unknown SHALL be 404 there; listing a room's recordings stays members only
scenarios: AC-004 open to anyone with the link

acs.text: WHEN the recorder uploads a media chunk THE SYSTEM SHALL keep it in the object store under `recordings/<id>/raw/<seq>` and nothing of it in Postgres but its count and the last chunk's hash, accept a retried last chunk as before, and remove every object of a recording when the recording is deleted
scenarios: AC-005 media in the object store

acs.text: THE SYSTEM SHALL delete the recordings made before this change and drop the media chunk table in its migration (D12)
